calibration: fixed economic thresholds; not a regime probability
missing_rule: Current observations and explicitly modeled inputs receive a score; modeled inputs retain a visible quality flag and sensitivity. Missing or stale indicators do not receive a score. Available indicators are reweighted within a component and coverage is published separately.
